post_result_lemmas.name: FINITE_COMPACT_MESSAGE_ESCAPE_FROM_BOOLEAN_ENUMERATION
post_result_lemmas.statement: On the frozen constructed mixed-language families with a supplied k-bit boundary, exact symbolic boundary messages grew linearly in k while the explicit assignment baseline is 2^k, and all 54 terminal joins used zero algorithmic boundary-assignment enumeration.

post_result_lemmas.name: K2_LANGUAGE_OVERLAP
post_result_lemmas.statement: The three non-cross-language cases were exactly GF2_PARITY+TWO_SAT_SIGNED_EQ at k=2. A two-variable XOR relation is itself equality/anti-equality, so the TWO_SAT_SIGNED_EQ projector is also an exact language for that component. This explains 51/54 cross-language joins without indicating a loss of exactness or compactness.

post_result_lemmas.name: ADAPTIVE_DISCOVERY_REORDERING_SIGNAL
post_result_lemmas.statement: In the second half of the holdout, advisory ProofMind/uncertainty/anti-dispersion ordering reduced median primary projector attempts from static 6 to adaptive 2 while protected challenger exposure remained nonzero. This is a finite scheduler signal, not a complexity theorem.

scientific_boundary.what_was_shown: Finite autonomous discovery and replay of compact exact boundary projections/messages on three frozen constructed mixed-language families with supplied k-bit boundaries.
what_was_not_shown: No theorem that arbitrary CNF admits any of these projector languages.
No theorem that arbitrary CNF admits a polynomially discoverable compact boundary message.

next_frontier: MAD-LAB V4: adversarial mixed boundary relations that are not wholly recognizable by one projector language; require composition of several partial symbolic messages on the same boundary, measure representation/discovery growth, and attack whether compactness survives as k grows without falling back to 2^k.
